title: What Can Ethereum Do for India? The Exam Leak Challenge
description:
In May 2026, a paper leak forced India to cancel NEET, its national medical entrance exam, after 2.2 million (22 lakh) students had spent months preparing. What would an exam system need to guarantee for students to trust it again?

In this hands-on workshop, you act as a mini citizens’ assembly. Weigh the trade-offs with live deliberation tools, then work in groups: design a proposal, stress-test another group’s, and rank the best. Where does Ethereum help, and where doesn’t it? 

No technical background needed. Bring your phone.
